purpose: Verify RGB-grounded selection of a two-arm bottle relay followed by the remaining dinner tasks through the actual language-command entry point.
models: models/dinner_suite/suite.json; all existing weights and metadata unchanged
entry_point: LabEngine._reset followed by LabEngine._language_command(mode=learned_dinner); no supplied skill list or simulator-position plan input
acceptance: Every expected step completes with unchanged physical monitors, stable release and both arms parked; drawer stays open and no later skill disturbs an earlier final placement by more than 4 mm.
development_gate: At least 3/4 complete development sequences before exposing final seeds. Otherwise preserve failures and diagnose under a separate revision before freezing.

scope: Existing finite left-reach bottle preset and dinner randomization. No general hand-to-hand exchange, new destinations, arbitrary language or new model training. Preserve all previous frozen experiments.
